menuEvidence.note: Michelin: 'serving delicious phở to the locals since it opened in 1968'; toppings include beef brisket, flank, tendon, tripe and meatballs.
Travel guides list it as a bánh mì shop; mia.vn gives a 2026 price range of 38,000–78,000 VND.
Michelin describes it as the only broken-rice (cơm tấm) specialty spot in the guide; known for broken rice with grilled pork chop.
Báo Quốc tế: a ~25 cm bánh xèo filled with shrimp, pork, bean sprouts, mung beans and onion; Michelin lists the shop for its bánh xèo.
Michelin: has been serving hủ tiếu Nam Vang to locals since 1975.
